description: Vague, evasive answers with no examples; blames others.

messages.text: I'm Asha, I studied computer science. I'm hardworking and a fast learner and I'm a team player.
Tell me about a conflict in a team.
I don't really get into conflicts. If someone disagrees I just do what they want so there are no problems, I think that's best for everyone.
I can't think of a real failure. Once a project went badly but that was because my teammates didn't do their part on time.
Tell me about a time you took ownership.
I always do whatever my manager assigns me, I finish my tasks and I don't usually take on extra things.
It's a good company and the salary is good, and I want to be a software engineer.
Thanks, that's all from me. The team will be in touch.
